classification_cases.label: Made for kids
classification_cases.intended_audience: Children are the primary or among the deliberately targeted audiences under applicable child-directed criteria
classification_cases.limitations: Classification needs actual intent and multi-factor review; no video genre or animation style independently proves this designation.

classification_cases.label: Mixed audience that is child directed
classification_cases.intended_audience: Children are one intentionally targeted audience, even if not primary
classification_cases.limitations: Mixed audience in COPPA context is not the same as content merely safe for a wide family audience.

classification_cases.label: General/family-friendly content
classification_cases.intended_audience: Content possibly appealing to all ages without deliberately addressing children
classification_cases.limitations: Animated characters, hobbies and family-safe presentation do not alone determine made-for-kids classification.

classification_cases.label: Teen-or-older general audience
classification_cases.intended_audience: Teen or adult viewers; not deliberately targeted at children under applicable child-directed criteria
classification_cases.limitations: This is about creator intent and content criteria, not a verified age composition of actual viewers.

classification_cases.label: 18+ age-restricted video
classification_cases.intended_audience: People aged 18+ who are signed in; different from children's content classification
classification_cases.limitations: Restricted from signed-out and under-18 viewing and most third-party embeds; ad availability may be limited.

made_for_kids_platform_impacts.source_limit: Disabled personalized ads do not imply no contextual ads, no views or zero revenue; exact payout effect unmeasured.

age_restricted_18_plus_impacts.notes: Viewer must be signed in and 18+, with policy and geo verification variations. Not equivalent to child-directed classification.

population_observations.frame: Ofcom 2025 online audience study, method reported by publisher
population_observations.limitations: Does not measure children of all ages, U.S. children, actual daily unique accounts or platform-wide child population.

population_observations.frame: Barb service-level home Wi-Fi YouTube viewing, Q2 2025
population_observations.limitations: Different age range, denominator and method from Ofcom 8–14 platform use; not 53% of children personally watching TV.

excluded_frame_warning: Adult-only surveys legitimately exclude minors; that exclusion establishes no zero-use claim about children and must not be filled by multiplying adult rates.
privacy_gates: No individual or device-level child profiles, raw histories, inferred age/gender/identity, pictures or comments may be collected for this study.
Use dated aggregate institutional statistics with explicit age range, geography and method.
Do not derive child populations by subtracting one adult survey percentage from another unrelated total.
Distinct format targeting and video classifier rules must be evaluated from intent and public policy, not assumed from title, animated style or presumed viewer demographics.
Do not publish guidance for circumventing minor protections or personalized-ad restrictions.
No sponsorship, RPM, creator profitability or number of children inferred from a platform feature restriction.

population_frame.eligible_parent_definition: Parent/guardian with child age 12 or younger
population_frame.sampling: Pew ATP and SSRS Opinion Panel nationally address-recruited parent panel; online or live telephone interviews, weighted parent sample
population_frame.sample_child_choice: One randomly selected child aged 12 or younger per eligible responding parent

product_configuration.product: YouTube Kids content-level settings, not creator Made for Kids audience tag

content_subcultures.description: Age-oriented songs and nursery rhymes, a possible child-directed signal under YouTube's multi-factor criteria
Early education, read-alongs, counting and exploratory play, to classify by intended audience and actual material
Animated stories with deliberate age-appropriate preschool audience; animation style alone insufficient
Animation for families or broad audiences may not be child directed, depending on content and intent

explicit_non_equivalences: Parent says the child watches YouTube is not evidence the child watched the YouTube Kids app or a video designated Made for Kids.
YouTube Kids Preschool recommendation setting is a product content-level option, not itself an uploader's Made for Kids audience declaration.
A cartoon is not inherently preschool content or child-directed under YouTube's multi-factor intent policy.
Pew 2025 U.S. parent reports cannot be compared directly with Ofcom or Barb UK child platform/device minutes, different ages and measures.
Survey respondent n and full-sample sampling error cannot be applied to children aged two to four without published subgroup denominators.
